1.explanation: This minimal example uses Grommet’s NameValueList and NameValuePair exactly as in your bug report. We set valueProps.align to 'start', which is meant to align the name and value elements vertically, but you’ll see the Text label sits at a different vertical offset than the Select component. You can run this in a create-react-app or CodeSandbox to observe the misalignment.
1.bug_scenario: In a Grommet NameValueList, when you use valueProps={{ align: 'start' }} to try to vertically center‐align the name (a Text element) and the value (a Select control), the two are actually rendered at different vertical positions. In the screenshot, the green line marks the Text baseline and the red line marks the top of the Select control’s display area – you can see they don’t line up horizontally.
